summary: Completed targeted GitHub connect regression validation across backend, frontend unit suites, and browser flows. Backend suites passed fully (55/55). Frontend targeted suites passed fully (38/38). Browser verified Add Project recovery flow, branch persistence (develop), no-opener bridge redirect to /projects?flow=connect-repo, and mobile/tablet/desktop Save CTA visibility. Pending-org approval banner verified on mobile. Real GitHub consent and live project creation were not end-to-end verified in this environment.

ui_bugs.issue: Login inputs/buttons on preview login page are not consistently discoverable by stable data-testid selectors (automation had to fall back to placeholder/type selectors).

issues: ORA guide popup overlaps lower wizard area, reducing clarity around lower controls on small screens.

action_items: Add stable data-testid attributes for login form fields/actions used in auth flow automation.
Tune/relocate ORA guide bubble in Add Project wizard for 390px viewport so it does not overlap modal controls.
Run one manual/live GitHub consent + repo selection + save flow on preview or staging to complement MOCKED browser fixture validation.
critical_code_review_comments: Several production files exceed 700 lines (e.g., Projects.jsx, AddProjectWizard.jsx, routers/github_app.py, routers/cto_projects/management.py, services/github_app.py); split into focused modules to reduce regression risk and improve maintainability.

Connect flow logic itself is now coherent: callback is treated as access grant only, explicit /cto/projects/add persists project, bridge redirects correctly to /projects flow, and installation/repo ownership checks are preserved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% targeted suites (38/38) + browser targeted flow pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and frontend targeted regression suites requested in this review all passed. Browser flow verification used deterministic route fixtures for GitHub status/add payload checks and bridge return behavior (MOCKED fixture-based for consent/provider responses). Pending org-approval banner also validated on mobile via real UI query params. A full live GitHub consent/install/repo-save E2E was not executed due unavailable user-controlled real consent session.
rca of the issue: Root-cause areas from prior failures appear addressed: grant-change detection now compares repository signature not count-only; callback completion stops connect race so success is not overwritten by denial; background sync scope is per attempted installation instead of global connected state; bridge no-opener path now lands on /projects flow; Add Project includes explicit existing-access recovery path. Current run found no regression in these areas.
